career_ladder.note: Super TET (Assistant Teacher Recruitment Examination / ATRE / Sahayak Adhyapak Bharti Pariksha) recruits primary school educators under the Uttar Pradesh Basic Education Board (Basic Shiksha Parishad). Recruits enter at Level 6 and advance through academic hierarchy and educational administration.

steps.designation: Assistant Teacher (Primary School / Classes 1-5 / Sahayak Adhyapak)
steps.source_label: UP Basic Education (Teachers) Service Rules 1981 (22nd Amendment)

steps.designation: Head Master (Primary School) / Assistant Teacher (Upper Primary School / Classes 6-8)
steps.source_label: UP Basic Shiksha Parishad Promotion Regulations

steps.designation: Head Master (Upper Primary School / Junior High School)
Block Education Officer (BEO / Khand Shiksha Adhikari)
Basic Shiksha Adhikari (BSA) / DIET Senior Lecturer
steps.source_label: UP Educational Service Gazetted Cadre Rules

exam_scheme.note: Super TET is a single-stage objective OMR written examination of 150 questions (150 marks, 150 minutes duration) across 10 subject domains. There is no negative marking. Final selection combines 60% written exam marks with 40% academic weightage.

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Assistant Teacher Written Examination (OMR Mode)
stages.source_label: Examination Regulatory Authority (PNP Prayagraj) ATRE Scheme

papers.paper_name: Environment and Social Studies (Paryavaran Evam Samajik Adhyayan)
General Knowledge and Current Affairs (Samanya Gyan Evam Sam-Samyiki)
Life Skills, Management and Aptitude (Jeevan Kaushal, Prabandhan Evam Abhivrutti)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 65% (97/150) for General; 60% (90/150) for Reserved categories

stages.source_label: UP Basic Shiksha Parishad ATRE Merit Formulation Rules

papers.paper_name: Composite Merit: 60% Super TET Written Score + 40% Academic Weightage (10% each: 10th, 12th, Graduation, B.Ed/D.El.Ed)

financial_package.note: Assistant Teachers in Parishadiya Primary Schools under the Uttar Pradesh Basic Shiksha Parishad are placed in Pay Level 6 (Pay Band ₹9,300–₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹4,200) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016. Teachers receive DA, HRA, and statutory allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 6 (Basic Shiksha Parishad Primary Teachers)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹35,400 with 58% DA (₹20,532), rural/semi-urban HRA (₹1,500 to ₹4,000 depending on school location), net of 10% NPS deduction (₹5,593) and GIS.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per UP government finance orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) based on rural/semi-urban school categorization
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% state government matching contribution
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
Vacation pay during summer and winter school recesses
Teacher development allowances and training benefits
